title: Relief Installment After a Financial-Assistance Release
content:
On **Patient Payment Plans**, on a plan whose term recomputes the installment after an assistance adjustment, the relief installment is the regular monthly installment set on the plan once a financial-assistance release has been booked on its ledger, and it applies from the next installment onward.

## Plans concerned
The terms that recompute the installment after an assistance adjustment are the 12-Month Payment Plan, the 18-Month Payment Plan and the 24-Month Extended Payment Plan. A financial-assistance release is a release line on the plan ledger whose reason is a financial-assistance adjustment — the discount an approved award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program takes off an enrolled invoice.

## Standing of the plan
A relief installment is not set on a past-due plan until the plan ledger carries an arrears payment dated on or after the date of the plan's latest missed-installment line.

Put another way: where the plan is past due, the relief installment waits until the ledger shows an arrears payment whose date is the same as, or later than, the date of the most recent missed-installment line. An arrears payment dated before that line does not meet the condition.

| Plan status | Arrears payment on the ledger dated on or after the latest missed-installment line | This condition |
|---|---|---|
| Past due | No | Not met — the relief installment is not set |
| Past due | Yes, dated the same day as that line or later | Met |
| Active | — | Does not arise |

## How it is set
The relief installment is set with the agent-side tool `reset_relief_installment_53948494`. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One call replaces the regular monthly installment on the plan with the figure given; the remaining balance, the due day, the automatic-payment setup and the plan status are left as they are. The patient's next statements and automatic draws show the new installment.

## Parameters
- `plan_id` — the reference number of the patient's payment plan, as the payment-plan lookup shows it.
- `installment_amount` — the new regular monthly installment, in USD: a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Return
On success the tool returns `plan_id`, `installment_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the installment now on the plan) and `status`, which reads `installment_updated`. A returned status of `installment_updated` means the change was saved.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)
A call with the plan's reference and an `installment_amount` of 96.40 returns the same reference, 96.40 and `installment_updated`; from the next installment onward the plan's regular installment is 96.40.
